ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with high-intensity (white) regions on distal lobes and low-intensity (black) regions centrally and along trailing edges; approximately 40% white to 60% black pixel ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two contiguous high-intensity white patches on the lateral quadrants of the fluke; central region and trailing edge boundaries are low-intensity black, forming a wide inverted-T shape.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with clearly defined pixel boundaries at the central division.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serration along the continuous trailing edge; right lobe distal edge exhibits sharper, more jagged pixel-amplitude peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature of the trailing edge terminating in pointed lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of low-intensity pixels within high-intensity regions, specifically on the distal upper portion of the right lobe and scattered speckling on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical black linear mark on the right lobe; a short horizontal dark line near the inner boundary of the left lobe white region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical dark linear mark ('liner' mark) on the right lobe ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Alphanumeric identification text 'NAHWC #0263 Liner' present in the lower margin of the frame.
